name: Uneecops (ERP services)
description_en:
Uneecops is an enterprise-software services provider. For this ERP catalog candidate, the reviewed offering is SAP Business One licensing advice, implementation, integration, customization, migration and related support—not one standalone software product called Uneecops ERP.

The company also markets SAP, Salesforce, analytics, cloud and other services. This profile separates the provider’s service scope from the underlying software’s vendor license and capabilities. No project was commissioned, partner accreditation independently checked or SAP system tested.
description_zh:
Uneecops 是企业软件服务提供商。本 ERP 候选实际核对的是 SAP Business One 许可建议、实施、集成、定制、迁移和支持，不是一款名为 Uneecops ERP 的独立软件。

公司还提供 SAP、Salesforce、分析、云等服务。本文区分提供商服务范围与底层软件厂商的许可能力，未委托项目、独立核验伙伴认证或测试 SAP 系统。

sections.title_en: Evaluate the provider and the underlying product separately
sections.title_zh: 分别评估提供商与底层产品
sections.en:
The SAP Business One page presents Uneecops services around an SAP product, while the broader company site lists other technology/service lines. Its module summaries describe the offered SAP solution; they should not be read as proof that Uneecops owns one universal ERP codebase or that every engagement includes those modules.

Ask which exact SAP product/version, provider deliverables, third-party extensions and customer responsibilities the proposal covers. The provider’s own partner statements were not independently verified against SAP’s directory in this research. This correction changes the interpretation of the existing record without approving a relationship or creating a duplicate product profile.
sections.zh:
SAP Business One 页面围绕 SAP 产品介绍 Uneecops 服务，公司主站还列出其他技术服务。模块概要属于所售 SAP 方案说明，不能证明 Uneecops 拥有统一 ERP 代码或每个项目包含全部模块。

方案应明确 SAP 产品版本、提供商交付、第三方扩展及客户责任。本次没有在 SAP 名录中独立核验提供商伙伴声明。这项修正解释原记录，不批准关系或新建重复产品档案。

sections.title_en: Make the implementation reviewable through deliverables
sections.title_zh: 用交付项使实施可验收
sections.en:
For a hypothetical manufacturer migrating to SAP Business One, define master-data mapping, opening stock/WIP and ledger balances, order/purchase/production workflows, user roles and integration ownership. The provider lists implementation, customization, migration, managed services and consulting, but those labels do not establish the exact contract.

Ask for a representative migrated order, a rejected approval, duplicate import handling and reconciliation to the prior records. Include training, handover and support boundaries. These are proposed procurement/acceptance checks, not work performed by this research or a guarantee of implementation success.
sections.zh:
假设一家制造商迁入 SAP Business One，应定义基础资料映射、期初库存在制及账务余额、订单采购生产、角色和集成责任。提供商列出实施定制、迁移、托管及咨询，但标签不能确立具体合同。

可要求代表性迁移订单、拒绝审批、重复导入处理及与原记录对账，并明确培训交接支持边界。这些是建议采购验收，本文未执行实施，也不保证成功。

sections.title_en: Partner package names do not replace a license agreement
sections.title_zh: 伙伴套餐名称不能替代许可协议
sections.en:
The licensing/pricing page read on 22 October 2026 offers Basic, Professional and Financial User packs, each with monthly/yearly subscription wording and Contact Us For Pricing. It identifies company size, users, data complexity, integrations, HANA/SQL, hosting and maintenance/support as proposal factors. No numeric SAP license or implementation amount was established.

Treat those pack descriptions as this provider’s commercial presentation and request an itemized scope. Confirm rights and entitlements under the actual software-vendor agreement; the partner webpage is not authority to approve redistribution, unlimited users or every feature. Currency and normalized monthly cost remain unknown.
sections.zh:
2026 年 10 月 22 日读取的许可定价页提供 Basic、Professional 和 Financial User 组合，均写月年订阅并要求联系询价；方案因素包括公司规模、用户、数据复杂度、集成、HANA/SQL、托管及维护支持。本次未确立数字 SAP 许可或实施金额。

这些组合说明应视为此提供商的商业展示，并要求分项范围；权利权限需按实际软件厂商协议确认，伙伴网页不能批准再分发、不限用户或全部功能。币种和归一月费保持未知。

sections.title_en: Deployment and support must identify the responsible parties
sections.title_zh: 部署支持必须明确责任方
sections.en:
The provider discusses cloud, on-premise and co-located arrangements and offers managed services. A proposal should identify who licenses the software, operates databases, patches extensions, monitors integrations and provides exports/backups/restores, rather than assuming all responsibility sits with one party.

The fit to investigate is a buyer needing an implementation/services engagement for a named ERP, with an internal process owner. It is not a self-service software comparison based only on a vendor name. Source-code license, verified SAP accreditation, local statutory coverage, SLA, migration quality and actual recovery remain unverified. No inquiry form was submitted, quote received or client reference independently checked.
sections.zh:
提供商讨论云、本地和共置安排并提供托管服务。方案应明确谁取得软件许可、运营数据库、升级扩展、监控集成及提供导出备份恢复，不能假定所有责任都归一方。

适合调查的是需要指定 ERP 实施服务、并有内部流程负责人的买家，不能只凭公司名称作自助软件比较。源码许可、经核实 SAP 认证、法定覆盖、SLA、迁移质量和实际恢复仍未知；未提交咨询、取得报价或独立查客户参考。
